description: Phát hiện từ t-9d12/t-076d (lead): detectCharset/scoreCharset trong src/lib/charset.ts chấm điểm yếu với legacy CJK dưới khoảng 6 byte, ví dụ GBK '中文' (4 byte) bị đoán là KOI8-R. Cần xem có cách chấm điểm tốt hơn cho input ngắn, hoặc chấp nhận và ghi chú.

handoff.summary: NO-CHANGE recommendation for t-e015. Reproduced GBK 中文 (d6 d0 ce c4) → KOI8-R. Root cause: common GBK pairs score 3.5/2 = 1.75 per high byte, whereas their all-lowercase Cyrillic reading scores 1.8; the same coarse score supports real KOI8-R words. Tested two bounded candidates (multi-byte score ×1.10 and ×1.25 only below 8 bytes). Each improves 中/中文 but regresses KOI8-R тест/привет. Reject these candidates; retain documented low-confidence/override behavior. This is evidence against these simple fixes, not proof no future language-aware solution exists. No commit created because no tracked file changed; no push. Independent reviewer codex:gpt-6-sol low verdict PASS for this no-change recommendation, with limitations noted. Lead ran on Codex runtime; exact lead model ID is not exposed within the session (requester can confirm its selected model); no other worker/oracle models ran.
candidate: /tmp/t-e015/baseline.ts, boost110.ts, boost125.ts — isolated experimental source copies
scope: Read src/lib/charset.ts and src/lib/charset.test.ts; no source files changed
verification: node /tmp/t-e015/compare.mjs: all 72 strings encode with zero unmappable characters. Exact detection accuracy before/A/B: GBK 5/7/7 of 8; Big5 4/4/4; Shift_JIS 8/8/8; EUC-JP 3/3/3; EUC-KR 8/8/8; windows-1251 7/7/7; KOI8-R 6/4/4; windows-1252 7/7/7; windows-1258 6/6/6. Each charset has 8 samples at multiple lengths. Final shipped after equals before.

Short (<8 byte) before/A/B: GBK 2/4/4 of 5; Big5 2/2/2 of 5; Shift_JIS 5/5/5 of 5; EUC-JP 1/1/1 of 5; EUC-KR 5/5/5 of 5; windows-1251 5/5/5 of 6; KOI8-R 4/2/2 of 6; windows-1252 5/5/5 of 6; windows-1258 4/4/4 of 6. All 23 samples >=8 bytes unchanged by both candidates.

Known low-confidence mistakes remain, including GBK 中文→KOI8-R, Big5 中文→EUC-JP, EUC-JP 日本→GBK.
Evidence artifacts are in /tmp; main should retain relevant table in task record before cleanup.

closed.summary: No code change; a simple fix trades one error for another. Lead (Codex) reproduced GBK 中文 (d6 d0 ce c4) → KOI8-R: the GBK pairs score 1.75 per high byte, while the lowercase Cyrillic reading of the same bytes scores 1.8. Over a 72-string corpus in 9 charsets, the two candidates (multi-byte score ×1.10 / ×1.25 below 8 bytes) fix GBK 中/中文 (short GBK 2→4 of 5) but break KOI8-R тест/привет (short KOI8-R 4→2 of 6); inputs of 8+ bytes are unchanged. Other low-confidence misses stay (Big5 中文→EUC-JP, EUC-JP 日本→GBK); the user can override. Reviewer codex:gpt-6-sol low: PASS. Main re-ran /tmp/t-e015/compare.mjs and got the same result.
